newsitem.title: UK: Gilts soar, Bund gap narrows after UK rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Gilts soar, Bund gap narrows after UK rate rise.

text.p: UK gilts surged over two points on Tuesday, dramatically narrowing the gap with Bunds, after a quarter point rise in UK interest rates to 6.25 percent and sweeping reforms to the country's monetary policy framework.
By 1036 GMT, June gilts was up 2-12/32 on the day at 113-16, just off its contract high of 113-19 and up from 111-06 before the rate move.
June short sterling was up 0.06 at 93.41 and the September contract was up 0.08 on the day at 93.21 from 93.10 before.
The 10-year gilt/Bund spread was at 158 basis points from 173 before the rate move.
